g.text: Shared linear colour scale centred at 1; blue < 1, orange > 1. Values are descriptive, without cellwise tests.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243442

g.text: Each panel is a 3 x 3 issue-year / forecast-horizon grid. The four panels use the same RW denominators.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243442

g.text: FDMC beats RW in 5/9 cells, below the predeclared 6/9 requirement. Near-white cells indicate ratios near one.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243442

g.text: Corrected SDMC v1 is a cross-stage reference; its contrast with v2 does not isolate one model change.
